sidecar_only_objective.what_pager_controls: Residual sidecar files (.trit), manifest-driven layer activation, budgeted residual set, per-layer on-demand loading
sidecar_only_objective.what_remains_normal: Base model weights (Q2/Q4 GGUF), all base tensor metadata, graph construction, KV cache
can_prove: Residual paging mechanics at C++ level
Budgeted sidecar activation (not all residuals loaded)
Per-layer on-demand loading vs batch loading
Integration hook points for future sidecar overlay

existing_hook_points.pattern: static std::unordered_map<int, SidecarLoad> g_sidecars; bool prt_load_sidecars(); prt_get_sidecar(layer)
existing_hook_points.insight: Batch loading all sidecars — replace with pager.activate_layer() pattern

recommended_file_placement.rationale: Easiest experimental location, no core pollution, compiles standalone
recommended_file_placement.future: Move to src/ when pager is proven stable

pager_api.config: prt_sidecar_pager_config { sidecar_root, manifest_path, max_resident_bytes, prefetch_distance, window_size, use_mmap, checksum_enabled, strict_budget, policy }
key_methods: bool init() — load manifest and validate
bool activate_layer(int) — load base+residual, enforce budget, update window
prt_residual_view get_residual(int, std::string) — get residual pointer + metadata
void enforce_budget() — evict until under max_resident_bytes
stats get_stats() — peak_resident, reads, evictions, cache_hits, wall_time
pager_api.residual_view: prt_residual_view { layer_idx, tensor_family, size_bytes, scale_offset, data_offset, data_ptr, is_null }
pager_api.ownership_rules: Pager owns all data; caller holds non-owning view only; views invalid after eviction

integration_flow.step_2: Base model loads normally via llama_model_loader (unchanged)
integration_flow.step_4: Before each layer L: pager.activate_layer(L) → load residuals, evict old, update window
integration_flow.step_5: During PRT matmul: if (!view.is_null) use sidecar else fallback to base
integration_flow.step_6: Memory guard: if resident_bytes() > budget → abort (optional)
integration_flow.fallback: get_residual() returns null_view; caller uses existing base path unchanged

preprocessor_workflow.input: Source GGUF model + Q2 base assumption + policy + budget
steps: Load GGUF metadata, identify tensor families
Compute ternary residuals per selected tensor
Pack to .trit format (3-bit/trit, float32 scales, CRC16)
Write per-layer residual files to sidecar_root/
Write manifest.json (index with offsets, sizes, checksums)

staged_implementation.28AM: Standalone prt_sidecar_pager.h/.cpp with fake .trit + fake manifest, no llama.cpp linkage
staged_implementation.28AN: Connect to manifest + .trit reader, validate checksums with synthetic data
staged_implementation.28AO: Runtime-adjacent probe: link against built llama.cpp, test layer activation
staged_implementation.28AP: Integration behind disabled --enable-prt-sidecar-pager flag (no compute change)
staged_implementation.28AQ: Offline residual decode parity with real .trit files from small model slice
staged_implementation.no_generation_until: All stages pass, budget verified, offline parity confirmed

risks.mitigation: View valid only during activate_layer scope; compute consumes immediately
Phase 28AQ offline parity test before integration
Use same family names as prt_shadow.h (ffn_up, ffn_down, etc.)
Log warning when fallback taken; track fallback count
Budget enforcement in activate_layer() — abort if exceeded

recommended_next: Phase 28AM: implement standalone prt_sidecar_pager.h/.cpp with fake .trit + fake manifest, validate complete API in isolation before touching any runtime
